title: Introspection may fail to show the composition of experience

statements.text: In reply to combination worries, introspection may fail to represent features experience has: an experience of red that seems simple may be composed of a complex microphenomenal array not normally discerned, as a taste that seems simple is built from sweet, sour, salty, bitter and umami. The reply shows only that introspection does not rule constitution out, not how it works.

sources.quote: it is in fact composed of a complex microphenomenal array that is normally not introspectively discerned
However, that response is only partial.
